candidate: RevealedLoadoutDraw: after a species reveals a move or original item, draw a complete compatible same-species set proportional to source team weight; observed level; source gender must match the public gender; reject level-illegal moves; preserve original/current item constraints. No compatible support keeps Layered fallback. No-reveal and on-pool paths unchanged.
adaptive_opponent: Force Misdreavus lead and initial Mean Look only; then let the unchanged blind opponent freely choose all legal moves and switches. It never observes own agent choices or hidden enemy sets.
other_opponents: same 8 explicit legal historical-core scenarios as previous experiment; stress retains fixed Perish script; natural free preview/play; onpool weighted product catalog
primary_endpoint: paired terminal outcome C-A in adaptive; C-B also reported. Stratified paired bootstrap95 across fixed opponent fixtures, plus exact discordant-pair sign test. Secondary stress and natural, separately reported.
promotion_requirement: Positive primary outcome evidence (lower95 C-A >0), no unresolved regression versus mode or ordinary-play controls; no adoption from action changes or belief coverage alone.
cap_handling: 0.5 conventional score, separately report caps and worst/best paired delta bounds; do not remove long games
limitations: Fixed bot opponents and 8 constructed teams do not estimate human ladder gains.
Whole sets are sampled independently across species; cross-species item/selection correlations are not modeled.
No-reveal species retain current modal imputation.
Marginal prior, if separately installed, applies only to slots not covered by full-set draws.
The adaptive bot may choose poor replies; measure actual Destiny Bond and switch use.

correction.reason: Public gender was being overwritten while source attack DVs were retained; reject source sets with a different gender to preserve full-set consistency. Correctness correction, not outcome tuning.
correction.reuse: A/B are unchanged. Re-run C for every old-version triplet; never combine obsolete C results into final outcomes. Future triplets use corrected binary. Metadata and input seeds must match when joining replacement C.
